# Whole Field — Homologia / Analogia

**Standing:** mature T09 Etymology whole-field. `HISTORY.md` remains the historical/philological carrier; this page governs how agreement, correspondence and proportion may be used across the essay's distinct registers.

## Why this field exists

The essay moves among mathematics, Śaiva metaphysics, Jungian psychology, language, topology, music and technical computation. Without a disciplined relational vocabulary, similarity quickly becomes false identity. **Homologia / Analogia** provides the grammar by which forms can answer to one another while remaining source-distinct.

Historical Greek meanings and morphology belong to evidence registers **1–2** where documented in `HISTORY.md`. Canonical cross-register use is normally **3 Operational homology**.

## Operations

### Homological agreement

Two fields are homological when a materially relevant **operation or relational structure** can be shown to correspond while each field retains its own object and evidence. A visual resemblance is insufficient. The comparison must state what is transformed, preserved, generated or returned in both cases.

Consumers include **A02 Copula**, **A12 Mono/Poly**, **A13 Dia/Syn**, **C06 Copula**, **C36 Complexio Oppositorum**, **C50 Dia/Syn**.

### Analogical proportion

Analogy relates different terms through a proportion, focal orientation or qualified respect without asserting univocal sameness. It is the natural Etymology office for **C63 Pros Hen / In Quantum**, where Aristotle and Eckhart remain source-distinct even though both can discipline cross-register predication.

Consumers include **A34 Idealism**, **A36 Integral Zero**, **C60 Idealism**, **C63 Pros Hen / In Quantum**, **C64 Paradox**.

### Research boundary

**C30 Psychoid Number** depends upon this field as a guardrail. Numerical, geometric or archetypal correspondences may be philosophically fertile while remaining only operational analogy until independent evidence raises their standing. Cross-domain recurrence is never a covert proof of common cause or common descent.

## Evidence law

```text
same operation across fields
≠ common historical descent
≠ doctrinal identity
≠ causal proof
```

A relation may remain important at register **3** without being demoted. The discipline is not sceptical reduction; it protects the relation from claiming a kind of warrant it has not earned.

## Relational growth

Homologia and Analogia themselves can generate new distinctions. When a comparison reveals both correspondence and irreducible difference, the achieved relation becomes a **seed/new participant** for another inquiry. This is Relational Form Growth rather than forced synthesis.

[the complete Permanence in Change whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/german-literature/goethe-permanence-change/WHOLE.md#goethe-two-ones-return) **qualifies** its own homology by keeping the whole poem in view. Blossom and foliage pass; fruit ripens beside germination; river, perceiving eyes and bodily capacities change; the name endures while its bearer is figured as a wave. Only after these losses does the final stanza gather beginning and end through the Muses' promise of imperishable content and form. The appointed relation to the two Ones preserves those differences instead of extracting an unchanged personal substance from the poem. The forty-line German sequence is the collated witness; Nims's English wording remains uncollated, and neither poetic term is a literal identity for native `0` or `1`.

**Depth Restoration:** exact Greek lexical/source histories and tradition-specific uses remain pending where `HISTORY.md` is not passage-complete. T09 operational discipline is current.

The full eightfold Neumann refraction is an operational crossing at register 3. Its source morphology, native derivation, geographical tellings and temporal histories retain different offices; the whole returns the exact operation by which they become comparable. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-paper-eightfold). The mathematical lift, digestive image and psychic return preserve retained difference at operational register 3, with their counted objects and source warrants kept exact. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-interposition).

### A whole that can qualify its comparison

The retained-difference operation **returns-to** [the Eros–Psyche whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/roman-latin/eros-psyche/WHOLE.md#psyche-native-return). The four labours have their own helpers and nested return; waking uses an arrow-prick; the pregnancy precedes the ordeals; the public marriage uses a possession idiom. [A13](../../arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) and [A27](../../arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) receive the author’s union-without-merger relation with those source differences active. Register 3 establishes the particular operational comparison; it cannot turn four narrated tasks into proof of the native two-plus-four derivation or historical identity between traditions.

# Homologia, Analogia, and the Discipline of Comparison

The essay needs a vocabulary for a difficult fidelity: several traditions can make one operation perceptible without becoming interchangeable, and a shared sound can sometimes call attention to an operation without becoming an argument for historical unity. Greek *homologia* and *analogia* give the field two old pressure-points—saying the same, and bearing a proportion. The project requires both, together with a sharper ledger of what kind of sameness has actually been established.

## Word record

| Term | Historical field | Relation held here | Project use |
|---|---|---|---|
| *homologia* | *Homou* / same + *logos*: agreement, avowal, correspondence in account or word. | **Philological descent / attested semantic field.** Exact ranges need Greek lexical and textual verification. | Names an agreement that must say in what respect it is an agreement. |
| *analogía* | Relation of proportion or correspondence in ratio. | **Philological descent / attested semantic field.** The project's *pros hen* discipline already gives this field a native philosophical office. | Holds similarity through a named proportion without declaring identity of content. |
| biological homology / analogy | Modern comparative biology distinguishes common structural origin from functional likeness without common descent. | **Technical descendant with a restricted domain.** It does not supply criteria for the relation between philosophical traditions. | A warning-image: resemblance needs a stated test; it does not license a transhistorical genealogy. |
| resonance, pun, phonetic synchronicity | Relations of recurrence or sound that may have no historical derivation at all. | **Poetic / phonic re-entry.** | Opens a question or crystallises an operation only when the entry says what is disclosed. |

The distinction matters especially because a powerful comparison can feel like proof. It is not. A relation between Śaiva *vimarśa*, Bohmian implicate order, Lacanian division, or a QL operation can be an **operational homology** only after the common operation has been stated and the different objects, historical lineages, and explanatory scopes remain present. The project does not claim that each tradition secretly formulates QL; it reads each as a distinct aperture through which a relation may become more articulate.

## Comparison ledger

Before a cross-word or cross-tradition use, name the highest relation actually earned.

| Relation | Minimum burden | Forbidden shortcut |
|---|---|---|
| **Cognacy / descent** | A documented historical linguistic relation with an appropriate lexical source. | Treating a shared sound, spelling, or modern sense as a root. |
| **Semantic development** | Attested stages in one language or an explicitly documented borrowing path. | Making every later philosophical use the inevitable meaning of the earliest form. |
| **Formal equivalence or isomorphism** | Definitions, transformations, and the invariant actually preserved. | Calling two diagrams “the same structure” because they look alike. |
| **Operational homology** | A named operation, the register in each case, and the consequence that survives the comparison. | Claiming common origin, secret influence, or doctrinal identity. |
| **Analogia / proportional resemblance** | A focal relation and an account of what differs. | Reducing the many terms to metaphors for one master term. |
| **Poetic re-entry** | The image or sound genuinely changes how a local operation can be perceived. | Smuggling it into historical, scientific, or theological warrant. |

This ledger makes poetic licence more, rather than less, exact. A pun can carry real authorial force once it declares itself as such. A historical claim becomes more usable once it stops carrying a poetic surplus it has not earned. The two can cooperate—the word can open the question and the source can correct it—without pretending to have one authority.

## *Homologia* inside the project's method

The project already calls its comparative discipline [*pros hen* analogia](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/12-core-theorem-bridge.md): many meanings and forms remain genuinely many while orienting toward one focal relation. *Homologia* can sharpen the complementary question: when do several witnesses actually speak in one account, ratio, or operation? The answer must stay local. A homology is never a blank cheque for “everything says the same thing.” It is a claim that a named operation has survived translation between registers.

The essay's two logics offer a working example. *Dia-ballein* and *sym-ballein* are not generic Greek decorations pasted over mathematics, myth, psychology, and computation. The native derivation begins with the relation `0/1`; the Greek verbs name two operations the derivation already needs—throwing apart and bringing together. The historical word-field gives the operations a linguistic and material body; it does not replace the theorem's derivation. A later echo among *vikalpa* / *saṃkalpa*, definition / relation, or divide / recombine can be recorded as operational homology only after its local difference has been taught.

## Source shelf and verification queue

| Needed evidence | First research address | Why it is needed |
|---|---|---|
| Greek *homologia*, *homologos*, *analogia* | LSJ; a selected Greek corpus; Euclid where relevant | Separate agreement, proportionality, and technical use rather than relying on English descendants. |
| Biological terminology | Richard Owen's 1843 use of homology; modern history of comparative anatomy | Keep the biological distinction within the field that gives it its criteria. |
| Classical analogy and *pros hen* | Aristotle's relevant logical and metaphysical passages in selected editions | Recover the philosophical discipline already active in the argument. |
| Comparative method in the essay | [Core Theorem Bridge](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/12-core-theorem-bridge.md) and the core theorem spine | Ensure that external terms do not displace the authorial derivation. |

## Argument routes

| Route | Work performed by the cluster |
|---|---|
| [Core Theorem Bridge](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/12-core-theorem-bridge.md) | Supplies a clear distinction between proportional refraction and identity-claim. |
| [Sym-Ballein](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/03-two-logics-and-sym-ballein.md) | Gives a test for comparison: the seam, provenance, and differing registers must remain visible. |
| [Computational Process Ontology](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/14-computational-process-ontology.md) | Keeps the Greek, Sanskrit, process, and technical inheritances plural inside a shared operational grammar. |
| [Language, Symbol, and Dialogue](../../histories/language-symbol-dialogue/HISTORY.md) | Places comparison inside the history of signification, dialogue, and translation rather than outside language. |
| [§4 · #3 — Lacan, Matheme, and Mytheme](../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/34-s4-p3-lacan-matheme-mytheme.md) | Lets formula and image retain their distinct carriers while a traceable operation crosses between them. |

This cluster names the relation of comparison; it does not adjudicate every comparison in advance. Each use must still recover the local source, proposition, and proof boundary.

submission-package/essay/symbolon/episte.text: --- title: "Whole Field — Homologia / Analogia" record_id: etymology-homology-and-analogy record_type: etymology-whole register: episteme claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Argued from the native Taylor field; historical relations separately scoped in the companion" status: T21-developed-awaiting-parent-review --- # Whole Field — Homologia / Analogia **Standing:** mature T09 Etymology whole-field. `HISTORY.md` remains the historical/philological carrier; this page governs how agreement, correspondence and proportion may be used across the essay's distinct registers. ## #0 — Distinct fields entering one comparison ### Why this field exists The essay moves among mathematics, Śaiva metaphysics, Jungian psychology, language, topology, music and technical computation. Without a disciplined relational vocabulary, similarity quickly becomes false identity. **Homologia / Analogia** provides the grammar by which forms can answer to one another while remaining source-distinct. Historical Greek meanings and morphology belong to evidence registers **1–2** where documented in `HISTORY.md`. Canonical cross-register use is normally **3 Operational homology**. The field has **two members**, Homologia and Analogia. Agreement, proportion and research boundary are three offices of their use; the boundary is the dyad's answerability to its objects. Writing the account in six positions unfolds that answerability without changing the field's cardinality. The historical development **returns-to** [Historical and Relational Branches](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md), which **historicises** the terms while [the protected history](HISTORY.md) retains its learning and provenance office. ## #1 — What survives the crossing ### Operations ### Homological agreement Two fields are homological when a materially relevant **operation or relational structure** can be shown to correspond while each field retains its own object and evidence. A visual resemblance is insufficient. The comparison must state what is transformed, preserved, generated or returned in both cases. Consumers include **A02 Copula**, **A12 Mono/Poly**, **A13 Dia/Syn**, **C06 Copula**, **C36 Complexio Oppositorum**, **C50 Dia/Syn**. The agreement is made inspectable by recovering two complete movements. In each, identify the terms before the change, the act that changes their relation, and the resulting difference that remains available for return. The comparison then states which of these relations corresponds. A common result alone is insufficient: cancellation and recognition can both end with a word such as “one” while giving that one incompatible offices. Conversely, different visible results can carry the same operation of retaining provenance through transformation. [A02 — Copula](../../arguments/A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) **defines** the identification-through-difference consumed here; [A12 — Mono/Poly](../../arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md) **grounds** its whole/many asymmetry. [A13 — Dia/Syn](../../arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) **tests** the comparison at the act of accounting: the polar line keeps a common axis; cancellation loses it; the syn-ballic relation carries the terms and their inverse reading into the result. The Greek names give these operations a linguistic office. The native derivation supplies their formal relation before that naming. The full authorial field **grounds** this crossing through [Taylor's theorem source](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md): `/ = −/−` brackets the six determinations `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`, and `1/0` makes the return-switch. Relation becomes conscious circumstance, question/assertion, energetic polarity, recurrence, personed context and differential exactness before turning toward its condition. The Being, Becoming and Knowing/unKnowing pairs cross the Essence, Constitution and Text-Texture folds; the sequence retains its inversions. A local comparison must locate itself in this movement. Taylor's `X/x` is determining capacity and its indefinite particular; a Jungian reading refracts that established operation and never supplies its notation. [C06 — Copula](../../concepts/C06-Copula-Identification-with-Difference.md) and [C50 — Dia/Syn](../../concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md) **extend** the distinction into reusable concepts. [C23 — Severance](../../concepts/C23-Severance.md) and [C24 — Fusion](../../concepts/C24-Fusion.md) **test** its two losses: separated terms become unanswerable to their relation, or merged terms cease to contribute their differences. Homological agreement requires enough articulation for either failure to be recognised. ## #2 — Proportion, focal dependence and the qualifying respect ### Analogical proportion Analogy relates different terms through a proportion, focal orientation or qualified respect without asserting univocal sameness. It is the natural Etymology office for **C63 Pros Hen / In Quantum**, where Aristotle and Eckhart remain source-distinct even though both can discipline cross-register predication. Consumers include **A34 Idealism**, **A36 Integral Zero**, **C60 Idealism**, **C63 Pros Hen / In Quantum**, **C64 Paradox**. [C63 — Pros Hen / In Quantum](../../concepts/C63-Pros-Hen-In-Quantum-Focal-Return-Qualified-Predication.md) **defines** three distinct grammars within this office. Proportional analogy compares a relation between terms with another relation. Focal predication makes different senses intelligible through one primary reference. Qualified predication states precisely the respect in which an assertion holds. Their coordination is authorial; each keeps its own test. C63's health example makes focality concrete. A person has health, a diet contributes to it, and a complexion indicates it. Contribution and indication are not interchangeable acts, although both point to health. “The just person insofar as just” performs a different restriction: predication through justice applies under that qualification, without certifying the person's every action. The first account orders several uses around a focus; the second identifies the respect of one use. The relation between these grammars is productive because their difference remains active. [A34 — Order of Dependence](../../arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) **extends** this precision into the Argued ontology **Subject/Consciousness → Mind/Objective Internality → Object**. Epistemic access through an image and ontological dependence upon its source have different directions. A comparison that preserves only the first would fail to carry A34's proposition. Historical sources can qualify an attribution without replacing this order with general uncertainty about representation. [A36 — Integral Zero](../../arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) **extends** the same office into acquired return: the sign's accumulated symbolic life retains its exact mathematical work while opening relations that the first advent had not yet acquired. ## #3 — The claim that the comparison actually makes ### Research boundary **C30 Psychoid Number** depends upon this field as a guardrail. Numerical, geometric or archetypal correspondences may be philosophically fertile while remaining only operational analogy until independent evidence raises their standing. Cross-domain recurrence is never a covert proof of common cause or common descent. Here “raises their standing” concerns an additional historical or empirical claim, not a ladder on which operational homology must climb to become legitimate. [C30 — Psychoid Number](../../concepts/C30-Psychoid-Number.md) **defines** an Offered inquiry into the efficacy of number across psychic and physical descriptions. Its formal identities remain exact; its historically situated Jung–Pauli questions remain source-specific; its computational extension must show what changes in an apparatus. Evidence for one office cannot silently settle another. The inquiry's value lies in the discriminating work it makes possible. The preserved relation must therefore be named at the appropriate grain. A formal isomorphism requires specified objects, a map and the structure preserved. A symbolic interpretation requires the whole image's movement and the exact transformation consumed. A technical proposal requires an observable consequence that can distinguish the proposed operation from its absence. An agreement discovered at any of these grains can return a new question to the others without borrowing their authority. ### Evidence law ```text same operation across fields ≠ common historical descent ≠ doctrinal identity ≠ causal proof ``` A relation may remain important at register **3** without being demoted. The discipline is not sceptical reduction; it protects the relation from claiming a kind of warrant it has not earned. ## #4 — The whole answers the comparison [A17 — Toroidal Circulation](../../arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) **tests** retained difference in a particular formal carrier: a loop on the torus can close while its lift on the covering plane retains an integer displacement. The musical kernel reaches an octave through `16/9 × 9/8 = 2/1`. The shared return carries a difference rather than deleting it, while winding displacement and frequency ratio remain distinct objects. [C52 — Dimensional Reframing](../../concepts/C52-Dimensional-Reframing-at-Zero-and-Infinity.md) **qualifies** the transition by keeping each change of mathematical setting explicit. Nothing in the comparison substitutes one topology, one interval or one image for the whole arche-topos. [C61 — Disclosure Architecture](../../concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture.md) **extends** this return into the relation among Matheme, Mytheme and Episteme. A formal expression, a whole story and a historically warranted account each disclose through a determinate aperture. Their relation is bidirectional: an imaginal source can give rise to a formal expression, and a formal articulation can alter how the image is encountered. The source/appearance relation is recursively situated. A real local Bimba can condition a subsequent disclosure while itself remaining dependent upon a wider source; recursion neither cancels its local source office nor promotes its record into ultimate ground. ### Received whole returns [the complete Permanence in Change whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/german-literature/goethe-permanence-change/WHOLE.md#goethe-two-ones-return) **qualifies** its own homology by keeping the whole poem in view. Blossom and foliage pass; fruit ripens beside germination; river, perceiving eyes and bodily capacities change; the name endures while its bearer is figured as a wave. Only after these losses does the final stanza gather beginning and end through the Muses' promise of imperishable content and form. The appointed relation to the two Ones preserves those differences instead of extracting an unchanged personal substance from the poem. The forty-line German sequence is the collated witness; Nims's English wording remains uncollated, and neither poetic term is a literal identity for native `0` or `1`. **Depth Restoration:** exact Greek lexical/source histories and tradition-specific uses remain pending where `HISTORY.md` is not passage-complete. T09 operational discipline is current. The full eightfold Neumann refraction is an operational crossing at register 3. Its source morphology, native derivation, geographical tellings and temporal histories retain different offices; the whole returns the exact operation by which they become comparable. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-paper-eightfold). The mathematical lift, digestive image and psychic return preserve retained difference at operational register 3, with their counted objects and source warrants kept exact. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-interposition). ### A whole that can qualify its comparison The retained-difference operation **returns-to** [the Eros–Psyche whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/roman-latin/eros-psyche/WHOLE.md#psyche-native-return). The four labours have their own helpers and nested return; waking uses an arrow-prick; the pregnancy precedes the ordeals; the public marriage uses a possession idiom. [A13](../../arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) and [A27](../../arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) receive the author’s union-without-merger relation with those source differences active. Register 3 establishes the particular operational comparison; it cannot turn four narrated tasks into proof of the native two-plus-four derivation or historical identity between traditions. ## #5→0 — An achieved comparison becomes a new participant ### Relational growth Homologia and Analogia themselves can generate new distinctions. When a comparison reveals both correspondence and irreducible difference, the achieved relation becomes a **seed/new participant** for another inquiry. This is Relational Form Growth rather than forced synthesis. [Relational Form Growth](../RELATIONAL-FORM-GROWTH.md) **defines** the return: an achieved relation enters the next inquiry whole, carrying its internal differences. No conjugate sextet is manufactured for E5, and `N / N′ → N+N′` remains distinct from `N → N×N`. Here the productive result is a better-articulated dyad. Agreement says which operation persists; proportion says how different terms can answer within a stated relation; the received result changes what must next be recovered from both fields. The return has an exact consequence. A poem's aftermath can alter the analogy made from its opening. A mathematical hypothesis can narrow a proposed map while preserving the operation that first made the comparison useful. An apparatus that fails to change as predicted returns a failed implementation claim, not a refutation of every formal or symbolic proposition carried beside it. [Historical and Relational Branches](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#e5-branch-return) **returns-to** this field with these differences made explicit. Consumers return their own operation, consequence and remaining question; E5 receives the correction without acquiring their authority. **Standing:** the comparative grammar is Argued; native derivations retain their individually declared standing; C30 remains Offered and empirical efficacy remains Open where untested. Greek word history, Aristotle, Eckhart and Owen retain separate source tasks. The companion distinguishes bounded research verification from canonical source admission and quotation readiness. These pages do not certify reciprocal consumer closure.

--- title: "Homologia / Analogia — Historical and Relational Branches" record_id: etymology-homology-and-analogy-historical-branches record_type: etymology-historical-companion register: episteme claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Paraphrased lexical and historical witnesses; Argued authorial relational development" status: T21-developed-awaiting-parent-review --- # Homologia / Analogia — Historical and Relational Branches ## #0 — A shared word opens different historical questions [The Homologia / Analogia whole-field](WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** this companion's question: what kind of agreement has a comparison established, and what difference makes that agreement informative? [The protected history](HISTORY.md) **historicises** the field through its word record and comparison ledger. This companion develops its Greek, biological and invariant branches as distinct movements. It does not replace that history or convert a lexical family into a continuous genealogy of philosophical, biological and mathematical doctrines. The distinction matters because the criterion changes with the question. Agreement between speakers concerns an account they can avow; proportion compares relations; anatomical correspondence asks which organ persists through varied forms; a formal invariant is preserved under a specified transformation. The essay brings these questions into relation through its own comparative operation. Historical borrowing or transmission remains an additional claim requiring its own evidence. The research addresses below are scoped internal references. The September 8 check recovered lexical entries, Aristotle's focal passage and Owen's glossary text; admission of these selected passages to canonical source houses remains a parent task. No quotation-ready passage cards are created here. The existing Flasch house continues to own the Eckhart evidence boundary. ## #1 — Greek agreement has speakers, terms and circumstances [The canonical LSJ house](../../sources/classical-philology/liddell-scott-jones/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon/SOURCE.md) **sources** the lexical edition and current online-transcription standing. Its five admitted entries include Logos; the two E5 entries below have been verified separately and proposed to the parent for admission. They are not yet admitted passage cards in that house. The consulted [LSJ entry for ὁμολογία](https://atlas.perseus.tufts.edu/dictionaries/entry/urn:cite2:scaife-viewer:dictionaries.v1:lsj-n73748/) distinguishes agreement and verbal consistency, assent or admission, and compacts, including terms of surrender. Its citations include Plato's *Symposium* 187b and *Theaetetus* 164c, Aristotle's *Topics* 110a33, and historical uses concerning treaties. These are **Paraphrased lexical findings, evidence register 2**; the cited passages remain individual retrieval tasks, not texts independently collated in this batch. The relational consequence is authorial. An agreed premise, a personal admission and a compelled settlement do different things. Agreement alone cannot certify truth, freedom of assent or retained difference. E5 therefore asks what agrees, by what act, and under which conditions. This distinction **qualifies** [A13 — Dia/Syn](../../arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md): apparent consensus can retain a relation or impose one pole's account upon the other. The word's semantic range supplies a question to the operation; it does not historically prove the QL distinction. The consulted [LSJ entry for ἀναλογία](https://atlas.perseus.tufts.edu/dictionaries/entry/urn:cite2:scaife-viewer:dictionaries.v1:lsj-n6926/) gives mathematical proportion, including Aristotle's ratio account at *Nicomachean Ethics* 1131a31, and distinguishes general proportion, analogy, grammatical analogy, relation and correspondence. **Paraphrased, register 2:** the semantic range exceeds a numerical equation, while its mathematical branch requires the ratios to be specified. Plato's *Timaeus* 31c–32c and the Aristotelian entries are lexical locators here; this check does not certify their complete textual contexts. The branch thus differentiates accountable agreement from proportional relation without fixing either word to every later use. Precise morphology, borrowing paths, and the separate dia-/syn-ballein lexical history remain register-1 tasks. No derivation from the protected history's shorthand “homou / same + logos” is promoted into verified morphology. [The whole-field's homological operation](WHOLE-FIELD.md#homological-agreement) **returns-to** these questions whenever a consumer needs a historical assertion rather than an authorial comparison. ## #2 — Focality and qualification meet without becoming one doctrine Aristotle's *Metaphysics* IV.2 begins from multiple senses of being and asks how they belong to one inquiry. In the consulted Ross translation, the health example distinguishes preservation, production, indication and receptivity; the medical example likewise distinguishes several relations to an art. The argument then turns to the primary term upon which dependent uses rely. The bounded passage is **Paraphrased, register 2**, checked in [Ross's Book IV, part 2](https://classics.mit.edu/Aristotle/metaphysics.4.iv.html); the project's Bekker locator is 1003a33–1003b19. It establishes focal ordering rather than one identical predicate possessed in one identical manner by everything named. [C63 — Focal Return and Qualified Predication](../../concepts/C63-Pros-Hen-In-Quantum-Focal-Return-Qualified-Predication.md) **extends** this into the author's worked example. Diet contributes to the health that a complexion indicates and a person possesses. The contribution does not become a sign merely because both are called healthy. This is why the source matters to the E field: several relations can be ordered without exchanging their functions. Eckhart enters through a distinct historical and theological carrier. [Flasch's *Meister Eckhart* source house](../../sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/flasch/flasch-2015-meister-eckhart/SOURCE.md) **sources** the current philosophical encounter with primary determinations, analogy, predicate/reversal and *in quantum*. Its contents and chapter-abstract coverage were verified; no page-level passage has yet been transcribed. Chapters 15–17 are the declared route into the German sermons and consolation material. Direct attribution to a particular Eckhart sermon or Latin passage requires that text's own locator. The authorial example in Draft 3, retained and developed in C63, predicates the just person through justice **insofar as just**. It exposes the respect under which the assertion holds; it does not generalise that qualification into approval of the person's every action. C63's conjunction of this grammar with focality is **Argued, evidence register 3**. Flasch's uncollated pages leave an attribution debt while the qualifying operation remains fully developed. This branch **qualifies** [A34 — Order of Dependence](../../arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md). The direction of knowing through a manifestation and the direction of that manifestation's dependence upon its source remain distinguishable. Aristotle and Eckhart do not become witnesses to one historically uniform idealism. A34 retains its own Argued ontology; E5 states the relation in which each historical encounter bears upon it. ## #3 — Owen's anatomical criterion changes the object of comparison Owen's 1843 *Lectures on the Comparative Anatomy and Physiology of the Invertebrate Animals* gives the pair a restricted anatomical office. Its glossary distinguishes an analogue by shared function across animals and a homologue by correspondence of the organ despite variation in form and function. **Paraphrased, register 2:** the relevant entries are printed pp.374 and 379, PDF pages 376 and 381 in [the Darwin Online scan](https://darwin-online.org.uk/converted/pdf/1843_Owen_Lectures_A5436.pdf). This batch checked the PDF's embedded text for both entries; image-level transcription and canonical source admission remain separate tasks. The historical consequence is precise: these definitions do not themselves formulate a modern evolutionary common-descent criterion. The protected history's modern-biological shorthand must therefore be read as a later disciplinary distinction, not silently inserted into Owen's wording. A subsequent evolutionary account would have to explain how descent changes the warrant for correspondence; its source and date remain to be supplied. No claim about who first coined the terms is made here. The branch's authorial return **qualifies** [C30 — Psychoid Number](../../concepts/C30-Psychoid-Number.md) and [C32 — Archetype](../../concepts/C32-Archetype.md). Shared function, recurrent appearance and common cause pose different research questions. A recurring numeral does not identify the process that generates it; a shared symbolic effect does not establish descent between traditions. Equally, Owen's anatomical test is not the admission test for every QL comparison. E5's operational relation stands through its stated transformation, while a biological or historical identification must meet its own burden. C30 remains Offered and productive as a research inquiry. ## #4 — An invariant belongs to its transformation The formal branch **returns-to** [A17 — Toroidal Circulation](../../arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) and **compares** its carrier with the musical return in the [native theorem source](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md). On the quotient torus, a closed path lifts to a path whose endpoints can differ by an integer lattice vector. In the musical kernel, `16/9 × 9/8 = 2/1` reaches the octave by retaining the factor that completes it. The native coordination concerns return with a retained difference. It preserves each object's exact operation and does not identify a displacement vector with a frequency ratio. This is the operative meaning of the coverage row's “preserving map or stated respect.” A comparison claiming formal equivalence must give the map and its hypotheses. A comparison of different registers must identify the respect in which their operations correspond and what does not transfer. Calling the latter a homology neither asserts a computed homology group nor borrows an isomorphism theorem. [C52 — Dimensional Reframing](../../concepts/C52-Dimensional-Reframing-at-Zero-and-Infinity.md) **qualifies** each change of formal setting; [C36 — Complexio Oppositorum](../../concepts/C36-Complexio-Oppositorum.md) **compares** an achieved holding of differences without reducing its psychic carrier to a number of diagram positions. The image branch is equally exact about its own carrier. [The whole-field's received-return section](WHOLE-FIELD.md#e5-whole-returns) **embodies** this discipline through Goethe, Neumann, Uroboros and Eros–Psyche: the consumed moment remains accountable to the whole's sequence, inversion and aftermath. In Taylor's Symbolon Dynamics, an attractor organises trajectories while an atlas relates situated disclosures. Those operations meet without becoming one mathematical object. [C61 — Disclosure Architecture](../../concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture.md) **extends** their bidirectional relation across registers. A real local Bimba can condition the next disclosure while that source itself stands in a further source/appearance relation; the recursion is part of its office. Poetic and phonic re-entry remains evidence register 4. A sound or image can disclose an operation with authorial force, yet its linguistic descent requires separate verification. The result returns a question to the lexical branch instead of rewriting the past to fit the image. ## #5→0 — Historical difference returns as a sharper relation These branches return three distinct contributions to [the whole-field](WHOLE-FIELD.md): Greek agreement specifies the circumstances of avowal; proportion, focality and qualification differentiate the ways a relation holds; anatomical and formal uses require an object-specific criterion. Their conjunction **extends** the Argued comparison discipline. It does not make the branches stages of one inevitable historical development. The resulting relation **returns-to** [Relational Form Growth](../RELATIONAL-FORM-GROWTH.md) as an achieved participant. E5 remains a dyad. Its historical differences are material for further comparison, while the research boundary remains an office of that comparison. A new source can correct a claimed borrowing or a textual attribution without demoting a native derivation. A failed preserving relation changes that particular comparison. An untested technical consequence remains an empirical question. **Source debts, independently scoped:** admission of the verified homologia/analogia entries to the existing LSJ house; Greek morphology and primary contexts behind the lexicon's citations; Euclidean proportion if that technical history is consumed; canonical admission of the checked Aristotle passage and the two Owen entries; selected Flasch pages and any directly quoted Eckhart text; the later evolutionary development of anatomical homology; explicit mathematical hypotheses wherever equivalence is claimed; observations for psychoid or technical efficacy. The source-house admission tasks do not authorise edits to protected HISTORY, and no protected text or source house was changed to produce this companion.

proposed_cards.title: Homologia
proposed_cards.markdown: ### q006 — Homologia **Paraphrase:** The entry distinguishes agreement and verbal consistency; assent, admission and concession; and compacts, including terms of peace or surrender. Plato, Symposium 187b and Theaetetus 164c, Aristotle, Topics 110a33, and the historical treaty citations are lexical witnesses here, not independently collated primary passages. The semantic range does not establish that every agreement is true, freely made or an instance of QL homology. **Locator:** s.v. ὁμολογία, agreement, admission and compact senses, including the peace/truce/surrender sub-sense. **Access:** [selected LSJ transcription](https://atlas.perseus.tufts.edu/dictionaries/entry/urn:cite2:scaife-viewer:dictionaries.v1:lsj-n73748/). **Verification:** named senses read 2026-09-08; no print-edition collation or exact quotation claim. **Consumer:** E5 historical Greek branch and homological-agreement office; evidence register 2, with the authorial comparison at register 3.

proposed_cards.title: Analogia
proposed_cards.markdown: ### q007 — Analogia **Paraphrase:** The entry distinguishes mathematical and general proportion, analogy including grammatical analogy, relation, and correspondence or resemblance. Aristotle, Nicomachean Ethics 1131a31, is a dictionary locator for the equality-of-ratios sense; Plato, Timaeus 31c–32c, is another cited witness. These primary passages were not independently collated. The range does not identify proportional analogy, focal predication and qualified predication as one historical doctrine. **Locator:** s.v. ἀναλογία, LSJ I–IV, including I.2 and II.2. **Access:** [selected LSJ transcription](https://atlas.perseus.tufts.edu/dictionaries/entry/urn:cite2:scaife-viewer:dictionaries.v1:lsj-n6926/). **Verification:** named senses read 2026-09-08 from the Scaife entry, retrieved via HTTP after the browsing tool's open error; no print-edition collation or exact quotation claim. **Consumer:** E5 analogy/Greek branches and C63's differentiated comparison grammars; evidence register 2, with the authorial coordination at register 3.
